# `round`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns `expr` rounded to `d` decimal places using HALF_UP rounding mode.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
round(expr, d)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- round, example 1
> SELECT round(2.5, 0);
3
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
